item.title: Livingston’s grand slam fuels Texas’ 13–3 run‑rule win
item.description: Josh Livingston crushed two home runs, including a grand slam, to lead No. 3 Texas to a 13–3 run‑rule win over USC Upstate and complete a weekend sweep at UFCU Disch-Falk Field.

item.title: Texas title: Longhorns crush South Carolina to win SEC women's hoops tourney crown
item.description: After splitting a pair of games during the regular season, the squads met in Bon Secours Wellness Arena with national seeding positioning on the line. The win for the Longhorns could potentially move them to the No. 3 overall seed and keep them in the Lone Star State at Dickies Arena in Fort Worth through the regional final. However, that won't be announced until Selection Sunday on March 15.

item.title: Paxton targets Austin ISD in Texas’ first 'bathroom bill' enforcement
item.description: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton’s office announced Friday it has notified Austin ISD of a citizen complaint via a state tip line alleging a violation of Senate Bill 8, also known as the Women’s Privacy Act or the “bathroom bill.”

item.title: Lawsuit names Austin mass shooter as Tesla employee accused in earlier assault
item.description: The lawsuit, filed March 5 in Travis County district court, alleges Tesla employee Ndiaga Diagne attacked a co-worker over 65 years old during a workplace break on Dec. 4, 2025.
